decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical OEM default configuration definitions.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
BIOS SYSINIT1 includes oemconf.inc and uses its DEFAULT_BUFFERS, DEFAULT_FILES, DEFAULT_FCBS and DEFAULT_CDSS definitions.
The saved SYSINIT1 probe listing places the four variables at module offsets 0299h, 029Fh, 02A0h and 02A2h; the prior module comparison maps target base to file offset 17878.
Direct comparison confirms target values FFFFh, 08h, 04h and 05h respectively match the probe.
limitations: The probe used temporary stub symbols for unresolved links and is not a full functional or target-identical BIOS build. ROMEXEC-specific configuration and complete core binary identity remain unverified.
